records.text: Blake Wynn said in a November 2025 Bring the Juice interview that he and Enclave and Key did a lot of political work, that he regularly spoke with Kash Patel and was good friends with Charlie Kirk, and that he sat next to Trump at Mar-a-Lago on election night 2024 alongside Elon Musk, Dana White, and Steve Witkoff, according to the article Owens read.
records.speaker: Blake Wynn

appearances.snippet: During a November 2025 interview on the Sports Focused podcast Bring the Juice, he said that he and Enclave and Key do a lot of work in politics. ... Wynn (Blake Wynn) also said that he regularly speaks with FBI director Kash Patel. And that he was good friends with Kirk (Charlie Kirk). In the same podcast, Wynn (Blake Wynn) recounted sitting next to Trump (Donald J. Trump) at Mar-a-Lago on election night in 2024 alongside Elon Musk, UFC CEO Dana White, and Steve Witkoff, Trump (Donald J. Trump)'s friend and special envoy.
